people.name: Jordan

translations.web: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”
translations.bsb: “Command the priests who carry the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan.”
translations.kjv: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
